reason: The three transformations and their separation are distilled from the pinned cannbot-dsl reference kernels (sparse_flash_attention.py, quant_lightning_indexer_dsl.py, attn_prologue.py, qwen_sparse_attn.py at commit 4519e5372a8b9306f7d823688c0cb8141ee34fb1) and the CANNBot DSL software contracts (commit f305e200aa4b1e1fed73cd21ff1f083b8df25a1e). No paired hardware timing campaign, leave-one-out ablation execution or hidden-input retention run was executed in this distillation pass, so this receipt records a source-grounded transformation hypothesis and verification contract without claiming a measured speedup.

factors.change: Keep Q_nope [G, 512] and Q_rope [G, 64] L1-resident per outer query block, gather sparse KV tokens in 2-row UB pairs (_gather_kv_pair_to_l1) before MTE3->L1 transfer, overlap AIC QK/PV matmuls with AIV online softmax across a 3-slot L1 KV ring (or 4-stage workspace ring for GQA sparse attention) via directional CrossCoreSetFlag/CrossCoreWaitFlag, and emit p_ub directly in NZ fractal layout [s2_tile // 16, G, 16] for copy_ub_to_cbuf.
signals: single-row sparse KV gather issues one MTE3->L1 transaction per token
AIC and AIV serialize on each s2_tile chunk without multi-slot L1 ring buffering
p_ub requires an extra transpose or HBM round-trip before Cube PV matmul

factors.change: Fuse row max, exponential rescaling (alpha = exp((m_prev - m_new) * scale)), unnormalized probability p, row sum and output rescaling inside a register-level @pto.vf_inline kernel guarded by pto.vmem_bar('vst_vld') before scalar get_value() reads; in the attention prologue, keep input X L1-resident across Matmul_QA and Matmul_KV, accumulate split-K partials with Kahan error compensation before RMSNorm, and fuse INTERLEAVE_HALF tail RoPE in UB.
signals: online softmax materializes intermediateUB tensors across separate VF launches
stale UB scalar reads occur when get_value() follows Tensor.store() without vst_vld barrier
attention prologue reloads X from HBM for KV projection or drifts on split-K RMSNorm

factors.change: Run MXFP4 (E2M1 + E8M0 [2, 2] group scale) 16x16x128 Cube MMA with L1-resident query and scale, split the [H, N_PER_SUB] L0C accumulator along M across dual AIVs via F322BF16 Fixpipe transfers and mode=4 directed CrossCoreSetFlag, apply ReLU in bf16 before widening to fp32 for head-weighted accumulation, and dispatch cached vs streaming vbitsort32+vmrgsort4 TopK at the total_n = 4096 boundary under an AICPU atomic task queue.
signals: full fp32 L0C-to-UB transfer and fp32 ReLU double Fixpipe and vconv traffic in the indexer
variable sequence lengths across batch/query rows cause severe core makespan imbalance
full-row UB sort overflows UB when total_n exceeds 4096

leave_one_out_arms.purpose: Evaluate the complete sparse MLA + prologue + MXFP4 lightning indexer pipeline.
Isolate the latency impact of 2-token paired UB->L1 gather, 3-slot CV ping-pong and direct NZ p_ub staging.
Isolate the register-fused online softmax and L1-resident X prologue reuse while retaining the vst_vld and fp32 rescaling correctness guards.
Isolate the F322BF16 split-M Fixpipe handoff, bf16 ReLU pre-filter, streaming TopK crossover and AICPU dynamic task scheduling.

fallback_boundary.no_l0c_to_ub_or_mx_mma_on_a2_a3: Direct L0C-to-UB Fixpipe and mx_m16n16k128 MXFP4 instructions require Ascend950 (c310); on Ascend910B/910_93 stage L0C through GM/L2 workspace with mode=2 CrossCoreSetFlag and use supported W8A8/W4A8 or bf16 MMA paths.
fallback_boundary.gqa_heads_or_dim_outside_tile_contract: If D != 512 or Dr != 64 in MLA-absorb, or G > 64 exceeds the [64, 512] L1 query slot, fall back to the general paged/FIA attention path rather than overflowing L1/UB.
fallback_boundary.missing_vst_vld_barrier: Never remove pto.vmem_bar('vst_vld') between vector UB store and scalar get_value(); it is a hardware memory-ordering prerequisite, not an optional tuning knob.

retention_rule: Only both_pass cases with verified numerical accuracy against the fp32 reference (including LSE and TopK index set overlap) enter a paired timing comparison. Correctness prerequisites (vst_vld barrier, fp32 online-softmax rescaling, OOB index masking, Kahan split-K compensation) remain active in every ablation arm.
